title: Bidirectional link verification (DIO→DAO→DAO-ACK timeout → exclude parent) not implemented in any stack (draft 3.3 MUST + 5.4, R-RPL-006/016)
description:
Spec: draft-lichen-rpl-lora-00 3.3 'RPL MUST use bidirectional link verification' + 5.4 procedure (receive DIO from candidate; send DAO; DAO-ACK within timeout ⇒ bidirectional; else mark link unidirectional and do not use as parent). Appendix-rpl sweep R-RPL-006/R-RPL-016, not-implemented, confidence high.
Evidence: no unidirectional/DAO-ACK-probe parent-gating machinery in any stack (repo-wide grep). Parent admission uses rank/ETX(/load) only: Rust select_parent (lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs:699-760), C dodag.c:336-353, Py dodag.py:703-727. DAO-ACK handling only gates short-address assignment (Rust address_assignment.rs:460 apply_dao_ack; C rpl_dao_process.c/rpl_dao_timing.c; Py dao_state/dao_manager lifecycle). No test could exist.
Suggested placement: per-stack parent-admission path (Rust lichen-rpl dodag.rs; C lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/dodag.c; Py lichen/rpl/dodag.py), plus the DAO-ACK emission dependency tracked in the root DAO-ACK bead filed this sweep. Note LoRa link asymmetry motivation in draft 3.3; asymmetric-link detection also appears in the lichen_diag epic (ldzz) — coordinate scope.
